includes: Fishing licenses, tackle, bait, fuel, ice, snorkel gear, food, nonalcoholic drinks & paddle boarding included in charter pricing
Taxes/fees, water, and Gatorade included in package pricing
blurb: Guests can enjoy custom boating trips including snorkeling, fishing, paddleboarding, island hopping, and beach picnics. Private charters are personalized by the captain to guest preferences and include visits to reefs and sand bars. Boat rentals allow guests to be their own captain exploring local waters with instruction.
extraNote: Boat reservation cancellations within 7 days incur 100% charge; 10 days during peak seasons · Boat rentals canceled within 72 hours incur $200 charge or deposit forfeited; weather cancellations no fee · Weather cancellations determined by captain or rentee; no charge if cancelled due to weather · Credit card cancellations incur 2.5% fee · Charter cancellations or modifications up to 7 days before trip free; later changes or no-shows charged $250 · Garden Cove Marina & Buzzards Roost restaurant, park in the gravel parking lot on Cayman Ln.
